verdict.rationale: Data export and portability is a fair axis for a payroll/HR SaaS, but the evidence never documents a full-account export, open file formats, or an offboarding path. A REST API and 'robust reporting' are only building blocks or adjacent features, not a documented export-and-leave capability. The community report of switching to TriNet says nothing about how data was moved.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can export all of my data in open formats and leave

citations.quote: The Paychex API uses Representational State Transfer (REST) architecture
Robust reporting and analytics across payroll and HR data
